issue resolution, and also got recognized for delivery excellence, collaboration, and customer impact (2020).

driving technical solutioning, API integrations, and go-live. Developed and
maintained relationships at various level within customer origination ensuring quick outcome, faster resolution, project delivery and customer success.

risks, and success metrics. Acted as the primary client escalation point, maintaining CSAT scores above 95% across complex implementations

transaction parameters, limits, and country-specific restrictions to streamline implementation, compliance readiness enhancing transaction success.
Conversions, Card migration, Portfolio conversion projects. I also handled projects across Issuing, Acquiring, and Payment Gateway platforms products.

interdependencies, maintained MOMs and RAID logs, and defined mitigation strategies to ensure seamless delivery with minimal client impact.
Gained deep understanding of Card Payments lifecycle; Authorization, Clearing, settlement, Chargeback, Tokenization and PCI-DSS (functional knowledge).

Acted as the primary client-facing implementation lead, ensuring clear communication,
stakeholder alignment, and responsible to maintain coordination
between Issuing bank, Card processors and Internal teams for the project success. Showcased exceptional negotiation and risk mitigation skills.
Developed and executed detailed implementation plans, owning scope, timelines, dependencies, and resource alignment across internal and client teams.
Collaborated with product SMEs, technology teams, and testing teams to enable API integrations, transaction flows, and scheme certifications.
Managing processor migration projects between payment scheme, Issuer, program manager, card manufacturer and multiple internal stakeholders
Developed deep expertise in Thredd issuer processing platforms and played a key role in building the Implementations team at Art Technologies from the
Supported in formulating the UAT and SAT test cases again the issuer use case for quicker testing phase and shorter implementation TAT.
Served as a subject matter expert in card operations, strengthening team understanding of day-to-day processes and enhancing domain capability across the
Drove continuous improvement,
reducing change request TAT from24 hours to 10 hours optimizing platform, domain, and team processes.
